// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const ATTENTION_SUBJECT_TYPES: readonly ["feed_item", "goal_decision", "source_fault"];

export interface AttentionApi {
    readonly query: AttentionQuery;
    readonly commands: AttentionCommands;
    readonly events: AttentionEvents;
}

export interface AttentionCommands {
    create(input: CreateAttentionEntryInput): {
        entry: AttentionEntryRecord;
        created: boolean;
    };
    ensureFeedItem(projectId: string, itemId: string, reason: Extract<AttentionReason, "manual" | "source_rule">, detail?: Record<string, unknown>): {
        entry: AttentionEntryRecord;
        created: boolean;
    };
    setStatus(projectId: string, entryId: string, status: AttentionStatus, expectedRevision?: number): AttentionEntryRecord;
    deleteSubject(projectId: string, subjectType: AttentionSubjectType, subjectId: string, ownerPluginId?: string | null): number;
}

export interface AttentionEntryRecord {
    project_id: string;
    entry_id: string;
    owner_plugin_id: string | null;
    subject_type: AttentionSubjectType;
    subject_id: string;
    reason: AttentionReason;
    status: AttentionStatus;
    detail: Record<string, unknown>;
    revision: number;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
    completed_at: string | null;
}

export interface AttentionEvent {
    event_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    entry_id: string;
    owner_plugin_id: string | null;
    type: `inbox_entry.${"created" | AttentionStatus | "deleted"}`;
    subject_type: AttentionSubjectType;
    subject_id: string;
    at: string;
}

export interface AttentionEvents {
    list(projectId: string, entryId?: string): AttentionEvent[];
}

export interface AttentionQuery {
    list(projectId: string): AttentionEntryRecord[];
    get(projectId: string, entryId: string): AttentionEntryRecord;
    findActiveForSubject(projectId: string, subjectType: AttentionSubjectType, subjectId: string, ownerPluginId?: string | null): AttentionEntryRecord | null;
    findForSubject(projectId: string, subjectType: AttentionSubjectType, subjectId: string, ownerPluginId?: string | null): AttentionEntryRecord[];
}

export type AttentionReason = "manual" | "source_rule" | "goal_decision" | "source_fault" | "artifact_out_failed";

export type AttentionStatus = "open" | "in_progress" | "done" | "dismissed";

export interface AttentionSubjectResolver {
    exists(projectId: string, subjectType: AttentionSubjectType, subjectId: string): boolean;
}

export type AttentionSubjectType = typeof ATTENTION_SUBJECT_TYPES[number];

export interface CreateAttentionEntryInput {
    project_id: string;
    owner_plugin_id?: string | null;
    subject_type: AttentionSubjectType;
    subject_id: string;
    reason: AttentionReason;
    detail?: Record<string, unknown>;
    entry_id?: string;
    at?: string;
}

export declare const attentionErrors: import("platform/action-errors").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly entry_not_found: "invalid";
    readonly revision_conflict: "conflict";
    readonly invalid_reference: "invalid";
    readonly invalid_transition: "invalid";
}>;

export declare const inboxErrors: import("platform/action-errors").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly entry_not_found: "not_found";
    readonly invalid: "invalid";
    readonly revision_conflict: "conflict";
}>;

export declare const modulesAttentionResumptionContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.module.attention-resumption.v1";
    readonly kind: "module";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "partial";
    readonly ssot: "docs/modules/attention-resumption.md";
};
